title: Hezekiah Celebrates Passover

questions.question: Who did Hezekiah send letters to?
options: All Israel and Judah, and also Ephraim and Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: All Israel and Judah, and also Ephraim and Manasseh
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:1 (ESV): "Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh..."

questions.question: What feast did they come to keep?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:1 (ESV): "...to keep the Passover to the LORD..."

questions.question: When did they keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:2 (ESV): "For the king... had taken counsel to keep the Passover in the second month."

questions.question: Why could they not keep it at the regular time?
options: Because the priests had not consecrated themselves in sufficient number
questions.correctAnswer: Because the priests had not consecrated themselves in sufficient number
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:3 (ESV): "For they could not keep it at that time because the priests had not consecrated themselves in sufficient number..."

questions.question: What did the couriers proclaim?
options: O people of Israel, return to the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: O people of Israel, return to the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:6 (ESV): "...O people of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham..."

questions.question: How did the people of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Zebulun react initially?
options: They laughed them to scorn and mocked them
questions.correctAnswer: They laughed them to scorn and mocked them
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:10 (ESV): "...but they laughed them to scorn and mocked them."

questions.question: Who humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem?
options: Men from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun
questions.correctAnswer: Men from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:11 (ESV): "However, certain men of Asher, of Manasseh, and of Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem."

questions.question: What did the hand of God give Judah?
options: One heart to do what the king and the princes commanded
questions.correctAnswer: One heart to do what the king and the princes commanded
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:12 (ESV): "The hand of God was also on Judah to give them one heart..."

questions.question: What did they remove from Jerusalem before the feast?
options: The altars that were in Jerusalem and all the altars for incense
questions.correctAnswer: The altars that were in Jerusalem and all the altars for incense
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:14 (ESV): "And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense..."

questions.question: Why did Hezekiah pray for some of the people?
options: They ate the Passover otherwise than as prescribed
questions.correctAnswer: They ate the Passover otherwise than as prescribed
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:18 (ESV): "...For a majority... had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover otherwise than as prescribed."

questions.question: What was Hezekiah's prayer?
options: May the good LORD pardon everyone who sets his heart to seek God
questions.correctAnswer: May the good LORD pardon everyone who sets his heart to seek God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:18-19 (ESV): "...May the good LORD pardon everyone who sets his heart to seek God..."

questions.question: Did the LORD hear Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:20 (ESV): "And the LORD heard Hezekiah and healed the people."

questions.question: How long did they keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:21 (ESV): "...kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with great gladness..."

questions.question: What did the whole assembly take counsel to do?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:23 (ESV): "Then the whole assembly taken counsel to keep another seven days..."

questions.question: What happened to their prayer?
options: It came to his holy habitation in heaven
questions.correctAnswer: It came to his holy habitation in heaven
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 30:27 (ESV): "...And their prayer came to his holy habitation in heaven."

key_verse_text: For if you return to the LORD, your brothers and your children will find compassion with their captors and return to this land. For the LORD your God is gracious and merciful and will not turn away his face from you, if you return to him.
